description: Lean corrective proposal for Grails Gone Wild / GGW Cards N Collects after baseline source sweep methodology correction. Adds readily discoverable official, social, review/directory, and non-MTG organized-play evidence; updates the Places assessment to reflect likely active TCG storefront status while preserving MTG Commander replay TBD. This is a targeted source correction, not a completed main store pass. Instagram content was inspected: it supports GGW identity and visible TCG/MTG activity through September 2025, including a stale July 2025 MTG prerelease signal, but not July 2026 activity or current weekly Commander. No event records are added or changed.

fields.assessment_notes: Grails Gone Wild should now be read as a Grails/GGW Cards N Collects alias cluster rather than a simple maybe-closed record. Presently current/current-looking sources support a conservative likely active TCG storefront read: KeepUp and Card Shop Hub point to GGW Cards N Collects at the same Torrance phone/address with hours, storefront routing, MTG among games available, and review texture; Ravensburger shows a May 2026 non-MTG organized-play event at GGW; and TCGplayer supports ongoing card-commerce depth. Instagram also supports the same store/location and linked storefront route, and it shows visible TCG/MTG activity through September 2025, including a July 2025 Edge of Eternities prerelease, but Instagram does not by itself prove July 2026 operation or current weekly Commander. This weakens the older physical-status concern from the MapQuest closed flag, but it does not prove the existing Sunday MTG Commander row is currently operational. Keep Grails visible as a likely active TCG-store lead and preserve the Commander row as a source-backed lead, but replay current MTG/EventLink or store-controlled social evidence before recommending it as a reliable personal Commander trip. This remains a targeted source correction, not a completed main store pass.

operations.reason: Replace overly pessimistic status-conflict wording with the updated alias/current-storefront read.

positives: Current/current-looking GGW Cards N Collects alias sources point to the same Torrance phone/address and support likely active TCG-store operation.
KeepUp and Card Shop Hub list current hours and TCG-shop activity, with MTG included among games available.

Instagram confirms the store-controlled Grails/GGW route, same Torrance location, storefront link, and visible TCG/MTG activity through September 2025, including a July 2025 Edge of Eternities prerelease post.
Ravensburger/Lorcana evidence supports current organized-play capability at GGW toys, though not MTG calendar truth.
Existing Wizards/EventLink data still supports a Sunday casual Commander lead worth replaying rather than discarding.
cautions: The existing Sunday Commander row still needs current MTG/EventLink or store-controlled replay before relying on it for travel.
The older MapQuest/Yelp-derived closed flag remains a conflict signal, though it is weakened by current GGW alias evidence.
Instagram's visible MTG evidence is stale/historical: the Edge of Eternities prerelease post was July 23, 2025 for July 25/26, 2025.
The latest visible Instagram post is September 2025 and appears Lorcana/product-oriented, so Instagram does not currently support ongoing weekly Commander.
Current evidence supports a likely active TCG storefront more strongly than it supports a proven casual Commander community.
This was a targeted source correction, not a full baseline main-store pass.
